notes.title: Untitled
notes.content: Embark on an epic adventure to save the idyllic world of Apo’s Paradise. After the tragic demise of its creator, a power struggle erupted, leaving the once peaceful realm in chaos. As the chosen hero, you can defeat your foes and restore harmony. With a simple yet strategic combat system, you’ll kick, dash, and teleport your way through stunning landscapes, facing formidable challenges and unforgettable bosses.

notes.title: At Daggers Drawn, out now on Steam!
notes.content: Hello everyone! My name is Swan Cannon and this is my first video game At Daggers Drawn. The reason why I made this game is to test out if I have what it takes to create a video game, I find riding a horse boring or any vehicle and even though there's an option for me to go parkour, I feel like that type of mobility will be saturated soon, I also find it fun to use a ball to move around the map without the top view pov making it as a weapon as a good enough reason to move with the ball since you need it to beat your enemies. Lastly, I want to thank all of you who wishlist and bought my video it means so much to me.
